mapper.insert: INSERT INTO instances (id, name, slug, status, port, dashboard_url, container_name, gateway_token, plugins_allow, plugins_entries, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{slug}, #{status}, #{port}, #{dashboardUrl}, #{containerName}, #{gatewayToken}, #{pluginsAllow}, #{pluginsEntries}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO instance_models (instance_id, sort_order, preset_id, provider_key, provider_id, model_id, api_mode, auth_type, auth_provider_id, auth_method_id, base_url, api_key, provider_config, extra) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{sortOrder}, #{presetId}, #{providerKey}, #{providerId}, #{modelId}, #{apiMode}, #{authType}, #{authProviderId}, #{authMethodId}, #{baseUrl}, #{apiKey}, #{providerConfig}, #{extra})

INSERT INTO instance_provisioning (instance_id, status, percent, stage, message, gateway_started_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{status}, #{percent}, #{stage}, #{message}, #{gatewayStartedAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO instance_model_auth (instance_id, status, message, output_snippet, auth_url, prompt_label, needs_input, updated_at) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{status}, #{message}, #{outputSnippet}, #{authUrl}, #{promptLabel}, #{needsInput}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE instance_model_auth SET status = #{status}, message = #{message}, output_snippet = #{outputSnippet}, auth_url = #{authUrl}, prompt_label = #{promptLabel}, needs_input = #{needsInput}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO instance_wechat_binding (instance_id, status, qr_mode, qr_payload, qr_link, output_snippet, runtime_ready, runtime_status, runtime_message, runtime_updated_at, updated_at, qr_expires_at) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{status}, #{qrMode}, #{qrPayload}, #{qrLink}, #{outputSnippet}, #{runtimeReady}, #{runtimeStatus}, #{runtimeMessage}, #{runtimeUpdatedAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{qrExpiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE instance_wechat_binding SET status = #{status}, qr_mode = #{qrMode}, qr_payload = #{qrPayload}, qr_link = #{qrLink}, output_snippet = #{outputSnippet}, runtime_ready = #{runtimeReady}, runtime_status = #{runtimeStatus}, runtime_message = #{runtimeMessage}, runtime_updated_at = #{runtimeUpdatedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, qr_expires_at = #{qrExpiresAt} WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wechat_paired_accounts (account_id, phone, instance_id, wechat_user_id, remark, base_url, saved_at, bound_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{phone}, #{instanceId}, #{wechatUserId}, #{remark}, #{baseUrl}, #{savedAt}, #{boundAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE instance_provisioning SET status = #{status}, percent = #{percent}, stage = #{stage}, message = #{message}, gateway_started_at = #{gatewayStartedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId}
